details.eligibility: Graduation in any discipline from a recognised university (as per the IBPS RRB notification on ibps.in).
details.pattern: Office Assistant: Prelims (Reasoning 40 + Numerical Ability 40, 45 min) + Mains (200 marks). Officer Scale I: Prelims + Mains + Interview. Officer Scale II/III: single written exam + Interview.
details.syllabus: Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning Ability, English/Hindi Language, Financial Awareness, Computer Knowledge, General Awareness.
